mock_data.title: No Planet B
mock_data.passage:
A New Scientist column by Graham Lawton on whether individual action can really tackle climate change when corporations and governments are failing.

I have been doing a lot of work recently on how narrow corporate interests are a seemingly insurmountable obstacle to making the changes necessary to stop the destruction of the environment. A few weeks back, I reviewed A Climate of Truth by Mike Berners-Lee, which makes a powerful case that dishonesty and obfuscation by climate-trashing industries are a major cause of environmental destruction. It reminded me of an interview I did a few years ago with Harvard science historian Naomi Oreskes, who has spent years exposing the tactics of corporate science deniers in the tobacco industry and oil and gas sector. I remember being dismayed by the depth of their deceit. Sadly, things have not gotten any better.

More recently, I've watched in horror as the new Donald Trump administration in the US strips away all environmental protections and slashes and burns related science, seemingly hell-bent on allowing private companies to do whatever they like in pursuit of profit. We are, it seems, fighting a losing battle.

It was against this disempowering background that some new research from the not-for-profit World Resources Institute (WRI) caught my eye. The headline read "The Most Impactful Things You Can Do for the Climate Aren't What You've Been Told". It would be, I hoped, a timely reminder that ordinary people are not powerless, plus some novel and actionable advice about how to live a climate-friendly life. So, I read the report.

First, the good news. By adopting pro-climate behaviours in just three areas of our lives – how we travel, how we power our homes and what we eat – it is theoretically possible for individuals to become carbon-neutral or even carbon-negative. The average person is directly responsible for 6.28 tonnes of greenhouse gas emissions a year, according to the WRI. Its analysis found that behavioural change can cancel that out completely, or even overshoot it by just under a quarter of a tonne.

What are these behaviours, I wondered, and why are they not what I've been told? Number one is to ditch petrol-powered cars and switch to electric vehicles (EVs), public transport or active transport such as walking or cycling. Going completely car-free can cut personal emissions by 30 per cent. Hmm, I think I knew that.

Next on the list is flying less, which can achieve an 18 per cent cut. Number three is installing solar panels, insulation and a heat pump at home, which – along with moving to a smaller property – can reduce emissions by 16 per cent. Switching to a plant-based diet can cut your emissions by about 13 per cent. Meanwhile, familiar but less impactful actions include recycling, composting, cutting food waste and marginal reductions in household energy use by, for example, switching to more energy-efficient appliances.

No obvious revelations there, but it is still good to know that individual behavioural changes can have a major impact. Right?

Here's the rub: even though these actions can theoretically wipe out the average person's carbon footprint (actually a concept invented by energy company BP in 2004 to divert attention from the hydrocarbon industry's impact on the climate and shift the onus onto individual actions), in the real world such actions typically make only a 10 per cent reduction. That is nowhere near enough to get to net zero.

To realise the full potential of behavioural change, people need the support of – wait for it – governments and corporations. That includes subsidising investments in heat pumps or cleaner vehicles, installing charging infrastructure for EVs, investing in public transport and bike lanes, and offering tasty plant-based meals in canteens. That appears to be the opposite of what is happening out there: the WRI report admits that the Trump administration, for example, wants to abolish tax credits that make EVs and home solar power more affordable. Governments are retreating from net-zero targets around the world.

That's not to say it can't be done, and the WRI report gives examples. The Netherlands introduced generous subsidies for home solar installations and allowed households to sell surplus electricity into the power grid, transforming a country that once had low uptake of home solar panels into the highest per-capita user in Europe. In Bogotá, Colombia, investment in cycling infrastructure has increased the number of journeys made by bicycle from 0.58 per cent in 1996 to 9.1 per cent in 2017.

I applaud the WRI for its timely reminder that individual behavioural change has a role to play in tackling the climate crisis. But I would rather they had told it straight: governments and corporations are failing us.
mock_data.passageB1:
I have been thinking a lot about how big companies are making it hard to protect the environment. They seem to only care about making money. I read a book called 'A Climate of Truth' by Mike Berners-Lee. It said that some companies are not honest about how they harm the environment. This makes it difficult to solve the problem. I remember talking to Naomi Oreskes, a scientist, a few years ago. She told me how companies that sell things like tobacco and oil have been hiding the truth about science for years. It was shocking to hear. Sadly, things haven't improved since then.

Recently, I was worried to see that the new government in the US is removing rules that protect the environment. They are also cutting money for science. It seems like they want companies to be able to do whatever they want to make a profit. It feels like we are losing this fight.

Then, I saw some new research from the World Resources Institute (WRI). It said, 'The Most Important Things You Can Do for the Climate Are Not What You've Been Told'. I hoped this would remind people that we can still do something. I also wanted to find some new ideas about how to live in a way that helps the environment. So, I read the report.

First, the good news. If we change our behavior in three areas – how we travel, how we power our homes, and what we eat – we can reduce our carbon footprint to zero or even less. The WRI says that the average person causes 6.28 tonnes of greenhouse gas emissions each year. But, according to their analysis, changing our behavior can cancel out all of those emissions. We can even reduce it by a little bit more.

I wondered what these behaviors were and why I hadn't heard about them before. The first one is to stop using cars that use gasoline and switch to electric cars, public transport, or walking or cycling. If you stop using a car completely, you can cut your personal emissions by 30 percent. I think I already knew that.

The next thing on the list is to fly less, which can cut emissions by 18 percent. The third thing is to install solar panels, insulation, and a heat pump at home. If you also move to a smaller house, you can reduce emissions by 16 percent. Eating a plant-based diet can cut your emissions by about 13 percent. Also, things like recycling, composting, and using less energy at home can help, but not as much.

So, it's good to know that individual actions can have a big impact. Right?

But here's the problem: even though these actions could get rid of the average person's carbon footprint (which, by the way, was an idea created by the energy company BP in 2004 to shift the blame from companies to individuals), in reality, these actions only reduce emissions by about 10 percent. That's not nearly enough to reach zero emissions.

To make these changes really work, people need help from governments and companies. This includes giving money to people who want to buy heat pumps or cleaner cars, building charging stations for electric cars, investing in public transport and bike lanes, and offering plant-based meals in workplace cafeterias. But it seems like the opposite is happening. The WRI report says that the government in the US wants to stop giving tax credits that make electric cars and solar panels more affordable. Governments around the world are also stopping their plans to reach zero emissions.

That doesn't mean it can't be done. The WRI report gives some examples. The Netherlands started giving a lot of money to people who installed solar panels on their homes. They also let people sell extra electricity back to the power company. This turned the Netherlands from a country with few solar panels into the country with the most solar panels per person in Europe. In Bogotá, Colombia, they invested in bike lanes. This increased the number of trips made by bicycle from 0.58 percent in 1996 to 9.1 percent in 2017.

I support the WRI for reminding us that individual actions are important for dealing with the climate crisis. But I wish they would have been more direct and said that governments and companies are failing us. We need them to take action.

It's time to start pressuring our leaders and businesses to do the right thing for the planet. We need to demand change and hold them accountable for their actions. The future of our planet depends on it. We can't just rely on individual actions. We need big changes from the top down. Let's work together to make sure our planet has a healthy future. We need to protect it now for the generations to come. There is no Planet B. We need to act now before it’s too late.

mock_data.passageC1:
The pervasive sense that vested corporate interests constitute a seemingly insurmountable barrier to meaningful environmental action has been weighing heavily on my mind. My recent review of Mike Berners-Lee's 'A Climate of Truth,' which compellingly argues that the systematic dishonesty and obfuscation perpetrated by industries complicit in environmental degradation are primary drivers of the crisis, only served to reinforce this conviction. This resonated with my prior interview with Harvard science historian Naomi Oreskes, whose years of research have exposed the Machiavellian tactics employed by corporate science deniers within the tobacco and oil and gas sectors. The sheer scale of their deception was deeply unsettling, and regrettably, the situation has only deteriorated since then.

More recently, the dismantling of environmental safeguards and the blatant defunding of climate science under the new Trump administration in the US, seemingly driven by a myopic pursuit of corporate profit, has been a source of considerable dismay. It often feels as though we are fighting a losing battle against forces that are both powerful and intransigent.

Against this backdrop of perceived powerlessness, new research from the World Resources Institute (WRI), a non-profit organization, caught my attention. The headline, "The Most Impactful Things You Can Do for the Climate Aren't What You've Been Told," offered a glimmer of hope. I was hoping this report would serve as a timely reminder of the agency that individuals still possess, while also providing novel and actionable strategies for adopting a more climate-conscious lifestyle. Consequently, I delved into the report's findings with considerable interest.

Initially, the news appeared encouraging. The WRI's analysis indicated that by embracing pro-environmental behaviors in three key areas – transportation, home energy consumption, and dietary choices – individuals could, in theory, achieve carbon neutrality or even become carbon-negative. The average person's direct greenhouse gas emissions are estimated at 6.28 tonnes annually, according to the WRI. Their research suggested that behavioral modifications could entirely offset this amount, potentially even exceeding it by nearly a quarter of a tonne.

Naturally, I was curious about the specific behaviors recommended and the reasons behind their perceived novelty. The primary recommendation was to abandon petrol-powered vehicles in favor of electric vehicles (EVs), public transportation, or active transportation options such as walking or cycling. Eliminating car use entirely could reduce an individual's carbon footprint by as much as 30 percent. While significant, this information was hardly groundbreaking.

The next suggestion was to reduce air travel, which could lead to an 18 percent reduction in emissions. The third recommendation involved installing solar panels, insulation, and a heat pump at home, coupled with downsizing to a smaller property, potentially reducing emissions by 16 percent. Adopting a plant-based diet could further reduce emissions by approximately 13 percent. More conventional, yet less impactful, actions included recycling, composting, reducing food waste, and making marginal improvements in household energy efficiency through measures like switching to more energy-efficient appliances.

While these suggestions were not particularly revelatory, it was still reassuring to learn that individual behavioral changes could exert a significant positive impact. Or so it seemed.

Herein lies the crux of the matter: despite the theoretical potential for these actions to neutralize an individual's carbon footprint (a concept, incidentally, coined by BP in 2004 to deflect attention from the hydrocarbon industry's role in climate change and foist responsibility onto individuals), their real-world impact typically results in a mere 10 percent reduction. This falls far short of the reductions required to achieve net-zero emissions.

To fully realize the transformative potential of behavioral change, individuals require the support of – and here’s the rub – governments and corporations. This support should include subsidizing investments in energy-efficient technologies like heat pumps and cleaner vehicles, developing comprehensive charging infrastructure for EVs, investing in robust public transportation systems and cycling infrastructure, and offering appealing plant-based meal options in institutional settings. However, this appears to be in stark contrast to the prevailing trends. The WRI report points out that the Trump administration, for instance, sought to eliminate tax credits that incentivize the adoption of EVs and home solar power. Moreover, governments worldwide are increasingly reneging on their net-zero commitments.

However, this is not to say that progress is impossible. The WRI report cites examples of successful interventions. The Netherlands, for instance, introduced generous subsidies for residential solar installations and permitted households to sell surplus electricity back into the grid, thereby transforming a nation with historically low solar panel adoption rates into a European leader in per-capita solar energy usage. In Bogotá, Colombia, strategic investments in cycling infrastructure have dramatically increased the proportion of journeys made by bicycle, from 0.58 percent in 1996 to 9.1 percent in 2017.

While I commend the WRI for its timely reminder of the role that individual behavioral change can play in addressing the climate crisis, I would have preferred a more direct assessment: that governments and corporations are, by and large, abdicating their responsibilities, leaving individuals to shoulder a burden that they cannot, and should not, bear alone. The onus cannot solely be on the individual when systemic change is so desperately needed. The imperative for collective action has never been greater, and to equivocate on this point is to do a disservice to the urgency of the crisis. We must galvanize action on all fronts, holding both corporations and governments accountable for their contributions to, and potential solutions for, this global challenge. The future of our planet hinges on it.

mock_data.translation:
Grem Louton tomonidan yozilgan New Scientist ustuni — korporatsiyalar va hukumatlar barbod bo'layotganda, individual harakatlar iqlim o'zgarishiga haqiqatan ham qarshi tura oladimi.

Men yaqinda tor korporativ manfaatlar atrof-muhitni yo'q qilishni to'xtatish uchun zarur o'zgarishlarni amalga oshirishda qanday qilib yengib bo'lmaydigan to'siq bo'layotgani ustida ko'p ishladim. Bir necha hafta oldin men Mayk Berners-Lining A Climate of Truth kitobini ko'rib chiqdim, u iqlimni buzadigan sanoatlar tomonidan aldash va chalkashtirishning atrof-muhit halokati uchun asosiy sabab ekanligini kuchli dalillar bilan isbotlaydi. Bu menga bir necha yil oldin Garvard fan tarixchisi Naomi Oreskes bilan qilgan suhbatimni eslatdi, u tamaki sanoati va neft-gaz sektoridagi korporativ fan inkorchilari taktikalarini fosh qilish uchun yillar sarf qilgan. Men ularning aldovining chuqurligi tufayli tushkunlikka tushganimni eslayman. Afsuski, vaziyat yaxshilanmadi.

Yaqinda men AQShdagi yangi Donald Tramp ma'muriyati barcha atrof-muhit himoyalarini olib tashlayotganini va tegishli fanlarni qisqartirib yoqayotganini dahshat bilan kuzatdim, go'yo tijorat foydasiga erishish uchun xususiy kompaniyalarga xohlaganlarini qilishga ruxsat berishga qaror qilganday. Biz, shunday ko'rinadi, mag'lubiyatga mahkum jangda kurashdamiz.

Aynan shu ruhsizlantiradigan fonda notijorat World Resources Institute (WRI) ning yangi tadqiqoti e'tiborimni tortdi. Sarlavha shunday edi: "Iqlim uchun qila olasiz eng ta'sirchan narsalar sizga aytilganlar emas". Bu oddiy odamlar kuchsiz emasligini o'z vaqtida eslatish bo'lar, shuningdek, iqlimga do'stona hayot kechirish bo'yicha ba'zi yangi va amaliy maslahatlar bo'lar deb umid qildim. Shunday qilib, men hisobotni o'qidim.

Avval, yaxshi yangilik. Hayotimizning uchta sohasida – qanday sayohat qilishimiz, uylarimizga qanday energiya berishimiz va nima yeyishimiz – iqlimga muvofiq xulq-atvorni qabul qilish orqali, nazariy jihatdan shaxslar karbon neytral yoki hatto karbon salbiy bo'lishi mumkin. WRI ma'lumotlariga ko'ra, o'rtacha odam yiliga 6,28 tonna issiqxona gazi chiqindilariga bevosita javobgar. Uning tahlili shuni aniqlashdi ki, xulq-atvor o'zgarishi buni to'liq bekor qilishi yoki hatto tonnaning to'rtdan bir qismiga yetmasdan oshib ketishi mumkin.

Bu xulq-atvorlar nima, deb hayron bo'ldim, va nima uchun ular menga aytilganlar emas? Birinchisi — benzinli mashinalarni tashlab, elektr transport vositalari (EV), jamoat transporti yoki piyoda yurish va velosiped haydash kabi faol transport vositalariga o'tish. Butunlay mashina ishlatmaslik shaxsiy chiqindilarni 30 foizga kamaytirishi mumkin. Hmm, buni bilgandim deb o'ylayman.

Ro'yxatda keyingi — kamroq uchish, bu 18 foiz qisqarishga erishishi mumkin. Uchinchisi — uyda quyosh panellari, issiqlik izolatsiyasi va issiqlik nasosini o'rnatish, bu – kichikroq uyga ko'chish bilan birga – chiqindilarni 16 foizga kamaytirishi mumkin. O'simlik asosidagi parhezga o'tish chiqindilarni taxminan 13 foizga kamaytirishi mumkin. Shu bilan birga, tanish, ammo kamroq ta'sirli harakatlar orasida qayta ishlash, kompostlash, oziq-ovqat isrofini kamaytirish va uy energiya iste'molini chekli kamaytirish, masalan, energiya tejamkorroq jihozlarga o'tish bor.

U yerda aniq kashfiyotlar yo'q, lekin individual xulq-atvor o'zgarishlari katta ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkinligini bilish hali ham yaxshi. To'g'rimi?

Muammo shuki: bu harakatlar nazariy jihatdan o'rtacha odamning karbon izini yo'q qilishi mumkin bo'lsa-da (aslida bu tushuncha 2004-yilda energiya kompaniyasi BP tomonidan uglevodorod sanoatining iqlimga ta'siridan e'tiborni chalg'itish va mas'uliyatni individual harakatlarga yuklash uchun ixtiro qilingan), real dunyoda bunday harakatlar odatda faqat 10 foiz qisqarishni ta'minlaydi. Bu net nolga yetish uchun yetarli emas.

Xulq-atvor o'zgarishining to'liq salohiyatini ro'yobga chiqarish uchun odamlarga — kuting — hukumatlar va korporatsiyalar qo'llab-quvvatlashi kerak. Bu issiqlik nasoslari yoki toza transport vositalariga investitsiyalarni subsidiyalash, EV uchun zaryadlash infratuzilmasini o'rnatish, jamoat transporti va velosiped yo'laklariga investitsiya qilish va oshxonalarda mazali o'simlik asosidagi taomlarni taklif qilishni o'z ichiga oladi. Bu tashqarida sodir bo'layotgan narsaning teskarisi ko'rinadi: WRI hisoboti tan oladi, masalan, Tramp ma'muriyati EV va uy quyosh energiyasini arzonroq qiladigan soliq imtiyozlarini bekor qilmoqchi. Hukumatlar butun dunyoda net-nol maqsadlaridan chekinib ketmoqda.

Bu buni amalga oshirib bo'lmaydi degani emas va WRI hisoboti misollar keltiradi. Niderlandiya uy quyosh o'rnatmalari uchun saxiy subsidiyalar joriy qildi va uy xo'jaliklariga ortiqcha elektr energiyani elektr tarmog'iga sotishga ruxsat berdi, bir vaqtlar uy quyosh panellarini kam ishlatadigan mamlakatni Yevropada aholi jon boshiga eng ko'p foydalanuvchiga aylantirdi. Bogota, Kolumbiyada velosiped infratuzilmasiga investitsiya velosipedda qilinadigan sayohatlar sonini 1996-yildagi 0,58 foizdan 2017-yilda 9,1 foizga oshirdi.

Men WRIni individual xulq-atvor o'zgarishi iqlim inqiroziga qarshi kurashda rol o'ynashini o'z vaqtida eslatganligi uchun olqishlayman. Lekin ular to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aytganlarini afzal ko'rardim: hukumatlar va korporatsiyalar bizni yutqazmoqda.

mock_data.translationB1:
Men atrof-muhitni himoya qilishni yirik kompaniyalar qanchalik qiyinlashtirayotgani haqida ko'p o'ylayapman. Ular faqat pul topish haqida qayg'uradiganga o'xshaydi. Men Mayk Berners-Lining "Haqiqat iqlimi" kitobini o'qidim. Unda ba'zi kompaniyalar atrof-muhitga qanday zarar yetkazayotgani haqida halol emasligi aytilgan. Bu muammoni hal qilishni qiyinlashtiradi. Bir necha yil oldin olim Naomi Oreskes bilan gaplashganim esimda. U menga tamaki va neft kabi narsalarni sotadigan kompaniyalar yillar davomida ilm-fan haqidagi haqiqatni qanday yashirib kelganini aytib berdi. Buni eshitish hayratlanarli edi. Afsuski, o'shandan beri vaziyat yaxshilanmadi.

Yaqinda AQShdagi yangi hukumat atrof-muhitni himoya qiluvchi qoidalarni olib tashlayotganini ko'rib, xavotirlandim. Ular, shuningdek, ilm-fanga pul ajratishni ham qisqartirmoqda. Ko'rinishidan, ular kompaniyalarga foyda olish uchun xohlagan ishni qilishga ruxsat bermoqchi. Biz bu kurashda mag'lub bo'layotgandek tuyuladi.

Keyin, men Jahon Resurslari Instituti (WRI) tomonidan olib borilgan yangi tadqiqotni ko'rdim. Unda shunday deyilgan edi: "Iqlim uchun qila oladigan eng muhim narsalar sizga aytilgan narsalar emas". Bu odamlarga hali ham biror narsa qila olishimizni eslatadi deb umid qildim. Men, shuningdek, atrof-muhitga yordam beradigan tarzda yashash haqida yangi g'oyalar topmoqchi edim. Shuning uchun hisobotni o'qidim.

Avvalo, yaxshi xabar. Agar biz uchta sohada - qanday sayohat qilishimiz, uylarimizni qanday quvvatlantirishimiz va nima yeyishimizda o'z xatti-harakatlarimizni o'zgartirsak - uglerod izimizni nolga yoki undan ham kamaytirishi mumkin. WRIning ta'kidlashicha, o'rtacha odam har yili 6,28 tonna issiqxona gazlari chiqindilarini chiqaradi. Ammo, ularning tahliliga ko'ra, xatti-harakatlarimizni o'zgartirish barcha chiqindilarni yo'q qilishi mumkin. Biz hatto uni biroz ko'proq kamaytirishimiz ham mumkin.

Men bu xatti-harakatlar nima ekanligini va nega ular haqida avval eshitmaganimni o'yladim. Birinchisi, benzin bilan ishlaydigan mashinalardan foydalanishni to'xtatish va elektr mashinalariga, jamoat transportiga o'tish yoki piyoda yurish yoki velosipedda yurish. Agar siz mashinadan butunlay foydalanishni to'xtatsangiz, shaxsiy chiqindilaringizni 30 foizga kamaytirishingiz mumkin. Menimcha, men buni allaqachon bilardim.

Ro'yxatdagi keyingi narsa - kamroq uchish, bu chiqindilarni 18 foizga kamaytirishi mumkin. Uchinchi narsa - uyga quyosh panellari, izolyatsiya va issiqlik nasosini o'rnatish. Agar siz kichikroq uyga ko'chsangiz, chiqindilarni 16 foizga kamaytirishingiz mumkin. O'simlikka asoslangan dieta iste'mol qilish chiqindilaringizni taxminan 13 foizga kamaytirishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, qayta ishlash, kompost qilish va uyda kamroq energiya ishlatish kabi narsalar yordam berishi mumkin, lekin unchalik emas.

Demak, yakka tartibdagi harakatlar katta ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkinligini bilish yaxshi. Shunday emasmi?

Ammo mana muammo: garchi bu harakatlar o'rtacha odamning uglerod izini yo'q qilishi mumkin bo'lsa-da (bu, aytmoqchi, 2004 yilda BP energiya kompaniyasi tomonidan kompaniyalardan aybni odamlarga ag'darish uchun yaratilgan g'oya edi), aslida, bu harakatlar faqat chiqindilarni taxminan 10 foizga kamaytiradi. Bu nol emissiyaga erishish uchun yetarli emas.

Ushbu o'zgarishlar haqiqatan ham ishlashi uchun odamlarga hukumatlar va kompaniyalar yordam berishi kerak. Bunga issiqlik nasoslari yoki toza mashinalarni sotib olishni xohlovchilarga pul berish, elektr mashinalari uchun zaryadlash stantsiyalarini qurish, jamoat transporti va velosiped yo'laklariga sarmoya kiritish va ish joyidagi oshxonalarda o'simlikka asoslangan taomlarni taklif qilish kiradi. Ammo aksincha bo'layotganga o'xshaydi. WRI hisobotida AQSh hukumati elektr mashinalari va quyosh panellarini yanada arzonroq qiladigan soliq imtiyozlarini to'xtatmoqchi ekanligi aytilgan. Dunyo bo'ylab hukumatlar ham nol emissiyaga erishish rejalashtirgan rejalarini to'xtatmoqda.

Bu buni amalga oshirib bo'lmaydi degani emas. WRI hisobotida ba'zi misollar keltirilgan. Niderlandiya o'z uylariga quyosh panellarini o'rnatgan odamlarga katta miqdorda pul bera boshladi. Ular, shuningdek, odamlarga ortiqcha elektr energiyasini elektr kompaniyasiga qaytarib sotishga ruxsat berishdi. Bu Niderlandiyani kam quyosh panellari bo'lgan mamlakatdan Yevropada har bir kishiga eng ko'p quyosh panellari bo'lgan mamlakatga aylantirdi. Kolumbiyaning Bogota shahrida ular velosiped yo'laklariga sarmoya kiritishdi. Bu velosipedda amalga oshirilgan sayohatlar sonini 1996 yildagi 0,58 foizdan 2017 yilda 9,1 foizga oshirdi.

Men iqlim inqiroziga qarshi kurashishda yakka tartibdagi harakatlar muhimligini eslatgani uchun WRI ni qo'llab-quvvatlayman. Ammo ular yanada to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bo'lib, hukumatlar va kompaniyalar bizni aldayotganini aytishlarini xohlardim. Biz ulardan chora ko'rishni talab qilishimiz kerak.

Sayyoramiz uchun to'g'ri ish qilish uchun rahbarlarimiz va korxonalarga bosim o'tkazishni boshlash vaqti keldi. Biz o'zgarishni talab qilishimiz va ularni o'z harakatlari uchun javobgar qilishimiz kerak. Sayyoramizning kelajagi bunga bog'liq. Biz faqat yakka tartibdagi harakatlarga ishonib qolishimiz mumkin emas. Biz tepadan pastga katta o'zgarishlarga muhtojmiz. Sayyoramizning sog'lom kelajagi bo'lishi uchun birgalikda ishlaylik. Biz uni kelajak avlodlar uchun hozir himoya qilishimiz kerak. B boshqa sayyora yo'q. Kech bo'lmasdan oldin hozir harakat qilishimiz kerak.
mock_data.translationB2:
Korporativ manfaatlar qanchalik mustahkam ekanligini ko'rib, sayyoramizni himoya qilish uchun zaruriy o'zgarishlarni amalga oshirish imkonsizdek tuyulishi odamning ruhi tushkunlikka tushishiga olib keladi. Yaqinda men Mayk Berners-Lining "Haqiqat iqlimi" kitobini o'qidim, unda iqlimga zarar yetkazadigan sanoatlarning halolliksizligi va aldovi atrof-muhitning buzilishida asosiy omil ekanligi kuchli dalillar bilan isbotlangan. Bu menga bir necha yil oldin fan tarixchisi Naomi Oreskes bilan qilgan suhbatimni eslatdi. U ko'p yillar davomida tamaki, neft va gaz sanoatlaridagi korporatsiyalarning ilmiy dalillarni inkor etish uchun ishlatgan taktikasini fosh qilish bilan shug'ullangan. Ularning aldov darajasidan hayratga tushdim. Afsuski, vaziyat yaxshilanmadi.

Yaqinda AQShdagi yangi ma'muriyatning atrof-muhitni himoya qilish choralarini bekor qilishi va tegishli ilmiy tadqiqotlar uchun moliyalashtirishni keskin qisqartirishi meni tashvishga soldi, go'yo ular kompaniyalarga foydani maksimal darajada oshirish uchun xohlagan ishni qilishga ruxsat berishga qaror qilgandek. Go'yo biz mag'lubiyatga mahkum jang qilayotgandekmiz.

Bu ojizlik fonida, nodavlat tashkilot bo'lgan Jahon Resurslari Instituti (WRI)ning yangi tadqiqoti e'tiborimni tortdi. Sarlavha shunday edi: "Iqlim uchun qila oladigan eng ta'sirli narsalar sizga aytilgan narsa emas". Men bu shaxslar ojiz emasligi haqida foydali eslatma bo'lishiga va atrof-muhitga do'stona tarzda yashash bo'yicha yangi va amaliy maslahatlar berishiga umid qildim. Shunday qilib, men hisobotni o'qidim.

Avvalo, yaxshi yangilik. Hayotimizning atigi uchta sohasida - qanday sayohat qilishimiz, uylarimizni qanday energiya bilan ta'minlashimiz va nima iste'mol qilishimiz orqali - shaxslar nazariy jihatdan uglerod-neytral yoki hatto uglerod-salbiy bo'lishi mumkin. WRI ma'lumotlariga ko'ra, o'rtacha odam yiliga 6,28 tonna issiqxona gazlari emissiyasi uchun bevosita javobgardir. Ularning tahlili shuni ko'rsatdiki, xulq-atvorda o'zgarishlar ushbu miqdorni to'liq qoplaydi yoki hatto chorak tonnadan kamroqqa kamaytirishi mumkin.

Qiziq, bu xatti-harakatlar nima va nega men ular haqida ilgari eshitmaganman? Birinchisi, benzin bilan ishlaydigan avtomobillardan voz kechish va elektr transport vositalariga (EV), jamoat transportiga yoki piyoda yurish yoki velosipedda yurish kabi faol transportga o'tish. Umuman olganda, mashinasiz yurish shaxsiy emissiyalarni 30 foizga kamaytirishi mumkin. Men buni allaqachon bilardim, deb o'yladim.

Ro'yxatda keyingisi kamroq uchish, bu 18 foizga kamayishga olib kelishi mumkin. Uchinchi raqam - uyga quyosh panellari, izolyatsiya va issiqlik nasosini o'rnatish, bu - kichikroq mulkka ko'chish bilan birga - emissiyalarni 16 foizga kamaytirishi mumkin. O'simlikka asoslangan dietaga o'tish emissiyalarni taxminan 13 foizga kamaytirishi mumkin. Shu bilan birga, tanish, ammo kamroq ahamiyatli harakatlar qatoriga qayta ishlash, kompostlash, oziq-ovqat chiqindilarini kamaytirish va, masalan, energiya tejaydigan jihozlarga o'tish orqali uy xo'jaliklarining energiya sarfini biroz kamaytirish kiradi.

Bu yerda hech qanday kutilmagan yangilik yo'q, ammo shaxsiy xatti-harakatlardagi o'zgarishlar katta ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkinligini bilish hali ham xursand qiladi. Shunday emasmi?

Mana muammo: garchi bu harakatlar nazariy jihatdan o'rtacha odamning uglerod izini yo'q qilsa ham (bu tushuncha aslida BP energiya kompaniyasi tomonidan 2004 yilda neft va gaz sanoatining iqlimga ta'siridan diqqatni chalg'itish va mas'uliyatni shaxslarga yuklash uchun yaratilgan), amalda bunday harakatlar odatda atigi 10 foizga kamayishga olib keladi. Bu nolga yaqinlashish uchun yetarli emas.

Xulq-atvordagi o'zgarishlarning to'liq salohiyatini ochish uchun odamlarga - taxmin qiling - hukumatlar va korporatsiyalarning yordami kerak. Bunga issiqlik nasoslari yoki toza transport vositalariga sarmoyalarni subsidiyalash, EVlar uchun zaryadlash stantsiyalarini o'rnatish, jamoat transporti va velosiped yo'laklariga sarmoya kiritish va oshxonalarda mazali o'simlikka asoslangan taomlarni taklif qilish kiradi. Kolumbiyaning Bogota shahrida velosiped infratuzilmasiga investitsiyalar velosipedda sayohatlar sonini 1996 yildagi 0,58 foizdan 2017 yilda 9,1 foizga oshirdi.

Iqlim inqirozini hal qilishda shaxsiy xatti-harakatlardagi o'zgarishlar muhim rol o'ynashini eslatgani uchun WRIga tahsin aytaman. Ammo ular yanada to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bo'lishlarini xohlardim: hukumatlar va korporatsiyalar bizni xafa qilmoqda.

Oxir oqibat, bu jamoaviy mas'uliyat. Biz faqatgina shaxsiy harakatlar hokimiyat tepasida bo'lganlar tomonidan boshqariladigan tizimli o'zgarishlar bilan qo'llab-quvvatlangan va kuchaytirilganda chinakam yutuqlarga erishamiz.

Mening ongimni doimiy ravishda korporativ manfaatlar mazmunli ekologik harakatlarga to'siq bo'lib tuyulishi hissi ezib kelmoqda. Yaqinda Mayk Berners-Lining "Haqiqat iqlimi" asarini ko'rib chiqdim. Unda atrof-muhitning degradatsiyasiga aloqador bo'lgan sanoat tomonidan amalga oshirilgan tizimli yolg'on va chalg'itish inqirozning asosiy omillari ekanligi ishonarli tarzda ta'kidlangan. Bu Harvard fan tarixchisi Naomi Oreskes bilan bo'lgan suhbatimda ham aks etgan edi. Uning ko'p yillik tadqiqotlari tamaki, neft va gaz sektorlaridagi korporativ fan inkorchilari tomonidan qo'llaniladigan makiavellistik taktikalarni fosh qildi. Ularning aldovining miqyosi juda tashvishli edi va afsuski, vaziyat o'shandan beri yomonlashdi.

Yaqin vaqtlarda AQShda yangi Tramp ma'muriyati ostida ekologik himoya choralarining bekor qilinishi va iqlimshunoslik fanini ochiqdan-ochiq moliyalashtirishning to'xtatilishi ko'r-ko'rona korporativ foyda ortidan quvish natijasi bo'lib, katta xavotirga sabab bo'ldi. Ko'pincha biz kuchli va murosasiz kuchlarga qarshi mag'lubiyatga uchrayotgandek his qilamiz.

Kuchsizlik hissi fonida "Jahon Resurslari Instituti" (WRI) nodavlat tashkilotining yangi tadqiqoti e'tiborimni tortdi. Sarlavha: "Iqlim uchun qilishingiz mumkin bo'lgan eng ta'sirli narsalar sizga aytilgan narsalar emas", degan umid uchqunini berdi. Umid qilamanki, bu hisobot shaxslarning hali ham ega bo'lgan vakolatini o'z vaqtida eslatib turadi, shu bilan birga iqlimga oid ongli turmush tarzini qabul qilish uchun yangi va amaliy strategiyalarni taqdim etadi. Shunday qilib, men hisobot natijalarini katta qiziqish bilan o'rganib chiqdim.

Dastlab, xabar dalda beradigandek tuyuldi. WRI tahliliga ko'ra, uchta asosiy yo'nalishda - transport, uy energiya iste'moli va ovqatlanish tanlovi - ekologik harakatlarni qo'llab-quvvatlash orqali shaxslar nazariy jihatdan karbon neytralligiga erishishlari yoki hatto karbon-salbiy bo'lishlari mumkin. WRI ma'lumotlariga ko'ra, o'rtacha odamning to'g'ridan-to'g'ri issiqxona gazlari emissiyasi yiliga 6,28 tonnani tashkil qiladi. Ularning tadqiqotlari shuni ko'rsatdiki, xatti-harakatlarni o'zgartirish bu miqdorni to'liq qoplashi, hatto deyarli chorak tonnaga oshib ketishi mumkin.

Tabiiyki, men tavsiya etilgan aniq xatti-harakatlar va ularning idrok etilgan yangiligi sabablari haqida qiziqdim. Asosiy tavsiya neft bilan ishlaydigan transport vositalaridan voz kechib, elektr transport vositalari (EV), jamoat transporti yoki piyoda yurish yoki velosipedda yurish kabi faol transport variantlariga o'tish edi. Avtomobildan butunlay voz kechish odamning karbon izini 30 foizgacha kamaytirishi mumkin. Muhim bo'lsa-da, bu ma'lumot yangilik emas edi.

Keyingi taklif havo sayohatini qisqartirish edi, bu emissiyani 18 foizga kamaytirishi mumkin. Uchinchi tavsiya quyosh panellari, izolyatsiya va issiqlik nasosini uyga o'rnatish, kichikroq mulkka ko'chib o'tish bilan birga, emissiyani 16 foizga kamaytirishi mumkin. O'simlikka asoslangan dietaga o'tish emissiyani yana taxminan 13 foizga kamaytirishi mumkin. An'anaviyroq, ammo kamroq ta'sirli harakatlarga qayta ishlash, kompostlash, oziq-ovqat chiqindilarini kamaytirish va energiya tejovchi maishiy texnika vositalariga o'tish kabi choralar orqali uy xo'jaligining energiya samaradorligini marginal yaxshilash kiradi.

Ushbu takliflar unchalik yangilik bo'lmasa-da, individual xatti-harakatlar o'zgarishlari sezilarli ijobiy ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkinligini bilish hali ham ishonchli edi. Yoki shunday tuyuldi.

Mana, masalaning mohiyati: ushbu harakatlarning odamning karbon izini neytrallashtirish uchun nazariy imkoniyati mavjudligiga qaramay (bu tushunchani, aytmoqchi, BP 2004 yilda iqlim o'zgarishida uglevodorod sanoatining rolidan e'tiborni chalg'itish va mas'uliyatni shaxslarga yuklash uchun o'ylab topgan), ularning haqiqiy ta'siri odatda atigi 10 foizga qisqarishga olib keladi. Bu nol emissiyaga erishish uchun zarur bo'lgan qisqarishlardan ancha past.

Xatti-harakatlar o'zgarishining transformatsion salohiyatini to'liq ro'yobga chiqarish uchun shaxslarga hukumatlar va korporatsiyalarning yordami kerak. Bu yordam issiqlik nasoslari va toza transport vositalari kabi energiya tejovchi texnologiyalarga investitsiyalarni subsidiyalashni, EV uchun keng qamrovli zaryadlash infratuzilmasini ishlab chiqishni, mustahkam jamoat transporti tizimlariga va velosiped infratuzilmasiga investitsiya kiritishni va muassasalarda jozibali o'simlikka asoslangan ovqatlanish variantlarini taklif qilishni o'z ichiga olishi kerak. Biroq, bu mavjud tendentsiyalarga butunlay ziddek tuyuladi. WRI hisobotida aytilishicha, masalan, Tramp ma'muriyati EV va uy quyosh energiyasini qabul qilishni rag'batlantiruvchi soliq imtiyozlarini yo'q qilishga harakat qilgan. Bundan tashqari, dunyo hukumatlari tobora nol majburiyatlaridan vozv kechmoqda.

Biroq, bu taraqqiyotning iloji yo'q degani emas. WRI hisobotida muvaffaqiyatli aralashuvlar misollari keltirilgan. Masalan, Niderlandiya uyda quyosh panellarini o'rnatish uchun saxiy subsidiyalar kiritdi va uy xo'jaliklariga ortiqcha elektr energiyasini tarmoqqa qaytarishga ruxsat berdi, shu bilan quyosh panellarini o'rnatish darajasi past bo'lgan mamlakatni aholi jon boshiga to'g'ri keladigan quyosh energiyasi bo'yicha Yevropa yetakchisiga aylantirdi. Kolumbiyaning Bogota shahrida velosiped infratuzilmasiga strategik investitsiyalar velosipedda sayohat qilish ulushini 1996 yildagi 0,58 foizdan 2017 yilda 9,1 foizga keskin oshirdi.

Men WRI ni iqlim inqirozini hal qilishda individual xatti-harakatlar o'zgarishi o'ynashi mumkin bo'lgan rol haqida o'z vaqtida eslatgani uchun olqishlayman, lekin men to'g'ridan-to'g'ri baholashni afzal ko'rgan bo'lardim: hukumatlar va korporatsiyalar, asosan, o'z mas'uliyatlaridan voz kechmoqda, shaxslarga ular yolg'iz ko'tara olmaydigan va ko'tarmasligi kerak bo'lgan yukni yuklamoqda. Tizimli o'zgarishlar shunchalik zarur bo'lganda, mas'uliyat faqat shaxsga yuklanishi mumkin emas. Jamoaviy harakat qilish zarurati hech qachon bunchalik katta bo'lmagan va bu nuqtada ikki xil ma'noni anglatuvchi so'zlarni ishlatish inqirozning dolzarbligiga nisbatan bepisandlikdir. Biz barcha jabhalarda harakatni faollashtirishimiz, korporatsiyalar va hukumatlarni ushbu global muammoga qo'shgan hissasi va uni hal qilishning mumkin bo'lgan yo'llari uchun javobgarlikka tortishimiz kerak. Sayyoramizning kelajagi bunga bog'liq.
